The component suite (apps/app/src/features/site-navbar/components/navbar-settings.test.tsx) run against main's
navbar-section.tsx at 36de1597a (with the two compact field tokens it imported from shared.tsx inlined), swapped in
for the new component. Most failures are structure main never had (row field labels, the save bar, validation, the
changed-fields-only payload). Three real regressions are shown in detail at the end.

 × NavbarSettings — fields and names > shows the stored navbar with every row field labelled, addresses and icons left to right, and no save bar
 × NavbarSettings — fields and names > computes each field name from its label and each Remove name from its row
 × NavbarSettings — the project scope saves > sends only what changed: a cleared CTA text as "", an untouched field not at all
 × NavbarSettings — the project scope saves > another writer's CTA, set during this save whose refetch then fails, survives a later link-only save
 × NavbarSettings — the project scope saves > CTA saved and its refetch fails: clearing it in the same scope sends "", judged against the confirmed save
 × NavbarSettings — the project scope saves > CTA saved, its refetch fails, a scope round trip: an edit elsewhere leaves the stored CTA alone
 × NavbarSettings — the project scope saves > a newer read without the CTA wins over an earlier save: editing another field sends only that field
 × NavbarSettings — the project scope saves > a late save for one site never reaches another site's form or payload (A → B → A)
 × NavbarSettings — the project scope saves > removing the last row of every list sends [] for each; kept rows keep their metadata
 × NavbarSettings — the project scope saves > sends row text as typed, drops only fully blank rows, sends half-filled ones and trims the icon
 × NavbarSettings — the project scope saves > a switch-only edit dirties, saves the explicit value and discards back
 × NavbarSettings — the project scope saves > a refetched switch updates a clean form, and a dirty one keeps its edit
 × NavbarSettings — the project scope saves > a failed save keeps the draft and its Undo, says why once, and claims nothing
 × NavbarSettings — the project scope saves > edits and a new blank row made during a save survive it and stay unsaved
 × NavbarSettings — the project scope saves > a save that leaves the draft unsettled keeps it and its conflict on screen
 × NavbarSettings — the project scope saves > another site starts clean, and coming back shows that site as stored (A → B → A)
 × NavbarSettings — the project scope saves > a real change elsewhere offers Use theirs and Keep mine
 × NavbarSettings — a language scope > shows the project's CTA URL and switches read-only, and writes labels in the language's direction
 ✓ NavbarSettings — a language scope > saves the full override with its non-empty pieces only, never a global field
 ✓ NavbarSettings — a language scope > every piece emptied sends navbar: null, so the language falls back to the project navbar
 ✓ NavbarSettings — a language scope > asks before leaving a dirty scope; staying keeps the draft, leaving starts the other scope clean
 × NavbarSettings — Undo > Add, Remove and Undo keep focus in the list, and Undo restores the row as it was beside newer edits
 × NavbarSettings — Undo > removing the only row moves focus to Add; Undo puts an anchor back with its icon
 × NavbarSettings — Undo > a late Undo after a successful save restores nothing
 × NavbarSettings — Undo > a late Undo after a refetch, a discard, Use theirs, a scope change or a site change restores nothing
 × NavbarSettings — Undo > Use theirs retires Undo for the list it replaces
 ✓ NavbarSettings — Undo > Undo is gone once the section unmounts
 × NavbarSettings — saving keys, lock and refusal > Enter in a field and Ctrl+S save once; IME, Shift+Enter and Alt+Ctrl+S do not
 × NavbarSettings — saving keys, lock and refusal > one save at a time: Ctrl+S during a save sends nothing more
 × NavbarSettings — saving keys, lock and refusal > a refused address is never sent: the field is marked and focused, with the validator saying why
 × NavbarSettings — saving keys, lock and refusal > a problem shows once its field is left, not while typing in an untouched form

What the three show on main:
- Clearing the stored CTA label: main's body carries six navbar keys and no ctaLabel (its "blank → undefined", which
  JSON drops), so the API's one-level merge keeps "Book a demo".
- Clearing a CTA just saved (refetch failed): main never sends the clear; the last body on the wire is still the first
  save's (ctaLabel "Start").
- A late Undo after a successful save puts the deleted link back into the saved draft (2 rows instead of 1).
